trans-unit.source: To post Site or Community URLs for articles into the case feed , you must have the Knowledge sidebar enabled in the Service Console and either a Salesforce Site or Community setup.
trans-unit.target: 要将文章的站点或社区 URL 发布到个案动态中，您必须在 Service 控制台中启用 Knowledge 边栏，并设置 Salesforce 站点或社区。
